blind_spots.blind_spot: WINGMAN cross-validates IoT signals inside C4ISR control systems with zero mention of DDIL
blind_spots.operator_reality: If WINGMAN's cross-validation layer sits on a C4ISR network monitoring autonomous vehicles and critical infrastructure, the canonical failure mode applies: an architecture built assuming continuous signal correlation across sensors will misbehave the moment the network is denied, degraded, or intermittent — exactly the environment C4ISR systems operate in during contested operations.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The product page frames the value entirely around trust/explainability/cyberattack-defensibility, never around the comms environment the cross-validation signals travel over.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: 'Leveraging advanced cyber-physical systems (CPS) and clustering machine learning can crosscheck signals in Internet of Things (IoT) systems that control critical infrastructure, autonomous vehicles, and C4ISR control systems- increasing accuracy, trust, and mission readiness.'

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Installed in a day, with no equipment downtime' claim has no accompanying sustainment or operator-training story
blind_spots.operator_reality: A fast install is not the same as a supported system — someone has to interpret WINGMAN's explainability outputs in the field and know what to do when it flags a sensor conflict; that person, their training, and who fixes it when it breaks is never addressed.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Marketing emphasizes ease of adoption (install speed, no downtime) as the sales hook, which is a pre-sale concern, not a post-fielding sustainment plan.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: 'Our Trusted AI solution can be installed in a day, with no equipment downtime, and increases the resilience of the existing IoT system.'

blind_spots.blind_spot: FuelSim simulates jet fuel performance in Air Force engines via digital twin with no ITAR/export-control or ATO language
blind_spots.operator_reality: A digital twin trained on Air Force jet engine performance and fuel contamination data is exactly the kind of technical data that triggers export-control and government-network accreditation requirements — a 3-person company with no visible compliance hire is likely to hit this wall before FuelSim moves past demo.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The product description is entirely about technical capability (contamination detection, fuel-waste reduction) with no acknowledgment of the data-handling requirements that come with Air Force engine telemetry.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: 'Leveraging artificial intelligence and digital twin technology can simulate the performance of different jet fuels in Air Force jet engines.'

opener_hook: ThermoAI's WINGMAN cross-validates IoT signals in C4ISR control systems under a $1.2M Air Force SBIR Phase II awarded in 2023.
what_they_do: Small AI startup building trust/cross-validation software for defense IoT/C4ISR systems (WINGMAN), industrial combustion optimization, and Air Force jet fuel simulation (FuelSim).
